# Monroe County, FL - Official Website

> Monroe County's official government portal providing comprehensive access to county services, departments, public records, emergency alerts, and community resources across the Florida Keys.

Monroe County government operates through a Board of County Commissioners and provides essential services including permitting, parks management, public records access, and emergency notifications to residents and visitors. The county leverages CivicPlus and CivicEngage platforms for citizen engagement and government transparency.

## Key Topics

- Monroe County Board of County Commissioners
- Public Records
- County Departments
- Emergency Alerts

## Core Government

- [Monroe County, FL - Official Website](https://monroecounty-fl.gov): Monroe County, FL official homepage with county services and resources
- [Departments](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/736/Departments): Directory of Monroe County departments and constitutional offices
- [County Departments](https://www.monroecounty-fl.gov/8): County departments directory and staff contacts
- [BOCC Meetings & Agendas](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/meetings): Board of County Commissioners meetings, agendas, and minutes
- [Mayor Michelle Lincoln](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/1050/Commissioner-Michelle-Lincoln): Commissioner Michelle Lincoln profile and biography
- [Mayor Pro Tem David Rice](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/1014/Commissioner-David-Rice): Commissioner David Rice profile and biography

## Services & Programs

- [Services and Programs](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/71/Services-Programs): County services, programs, permits, and bid opportunities
- [Permitting Fees, Forms & Applications](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/160/Permitting-Fees-Forms-Applications): Building permits, fees, forms, and permit applications
- [RESTORE Act](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/restoreact): RESTORE Act Gulf Coast restoration and recovery projects

## Community Resources

- [Our Community](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/738/Our-Community): Community resources, parks, housing authority, and local arts
- [Parks & Beaches](https://www.monroecounty-fl.gov/1327): Parks, beaches, boat ramps, and recreational facilities
- [Calendar](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/calendar.aspx): Public events and government meetings calendar

## Public Records & Information

- [Monroe County Public Records](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/1036/Monroe-County-Public-Records): Public records requests and portal for government documents
- [Public Notices](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/publicnotices): Government announcements, floodplain notices, and meeting schedules
- [Staff Directory](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/directory): County staff directory and contact information

## Emergency & Alerts

- [SIGN UP: Alert!Monroe and Notify Me](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/1006/AlertMonroe-and-Notify-Me-Sign-Up): Emergency alert signup for Alert!Monroe notification system
- [News Flash](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/CivicAlerts.aspx): County news, scam alerts, and infrastructure updates

## Navigation & Support

- [Find It Fast](https://monroecounty-fl.gov/740/Find-It-Fast): Quick links to services, permits, records, and emergency alerts
